messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging detected: streaming-decode p99 spike > 3.5s across us-west cluster (multiple nodes). Auto-alert triggered at 1746001228. link: https://console.redwood/alerts/1746001228

maria_sre: seeing it in Grafana too — p95 ~ 900ms, p99 ~ 3.8s on streaming-tail route. 35% of requests affected in last 5m.

kai_runtime: noticed a new kernel roll forwarded to the fleet ~2h ago (trt8 + flashattn build). rolling window aligns.

josh_oncall: customer impact? any high-priority customers seeing errors?

manual note: devops-bot: routed 12 instances to fallback pool while autoscaler re-evaluates capacity.

anita_engineer: quick dump of decode logs from one affected node:
```
[1746001201] decode: tail latency 4050ms model=gpt-16k variant=fp16-trt8
[1746001202] kvcache: pagefault evict_count=18
[1746001202] kernel: compilepath: using kernel v2026-03-12-optim
```

kai_runtime: that kernel tag v2026-03-12-optim was the one that enabled the new fused FlashAttention kernels + a compiler flag tweak (-faggressive-inline). suspecting paging/evictions interaction with new kernels.

maria_sre: initial mitigation: can we pin traffic to previous kernel variant and drain the new one?

anita_engineer: yes — we have a pinned variant v2026-03-08-stable. can trigger controlled rollback on a subset of nodes. recommended: 20% -> 50% -> 100% ramp.

josh_oncall: doing canary rollback to v2026-03-08-stable on us-west-1 pool now. command: `infractl nodes apply --pool us-west-1 --kernel v2026-03-08-stable --max-unavailable 2`

kai_runtime: noted. also creating a temporary routing policy to divert streaming traffic to low-latency pool (us-east fallback) for heavy tails. `routes update --route streaming-tail --weights us-west-1:60 us-east-1:40`

maria_sre: dashboards show immediate improvement on nodes where kernel pinned — p99 dropped to ~1.1s on those hosts. overall cluster p99 still ~2.2s while rollout continues.

eng-runtime: can someone capture the compile flags and exact kernel build hash? will need it for a reproduce-then-fix ticket.

anita_engineer: build info attached (copied): `build_hash=5f9c2a`, flags=`-O3 -faggressive-inline -mavx2 -DTRT_FLASH_ATTN` and nvcc toolchain nvcc_12.2. Some kernels show higher memory working set.

sre_lead: opening an incident doc and tagging ENG RUNTIME + ML infra. link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-1746001 — include repro steps, customer list, and timeline.

josh_oncall: passing to daytime oncall, @kai_runtime you're the eng runtime lead for followup. handoff note: rollback in progress, partial mitigation successful, next steps: reproduce locally with kernel 5f9c2a, run memprofs on KV cache, and consider adding a short-term compiler flag rollback (-fno-aggressive-inline).

kai_runtime: acked. will take it. creating a follow-up thread in #eng-runtime for root cause and fix plan. please ping if customer escalations arrive. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-1746001 updated: status=mitigated (partial), severity=sev2, summary="Streaming decode tail spike likely linked to new kernel + compiler flag; rollback underway"
